name: @w6w-apps/zuora
description: Manage customer accounts, subscriptions, invoices, payments and orders in Zuora, across every Zuora region and cloud.

w6w.longDescription:
Zuora is a subscription billing and monetization platform. This app puts the core billing objects into a workflow: list, read, create and update customer accounts; list, read and create subscriptions; list and read invoices and payments; and create and read orders for anything beyond a single subscription's lifecycle.

Zuora runs each tenant in one of ten hosts spanning three regions (US, EU, APAC) and, for the US, two clouds, plus developer/central and API sandboxes per region — this app's Auth method routes every request through the tenant's own host rather than assuming one region, because a credential minted against one Zuora data centre is unknown to any other.

Every list action goes through Zuora's Object Query API rather than the older per-resource endpoints, because Object Query is the one part of the v1 API with a real, generic list operation (cursor pagination, `field.OP:value` filters) that isn't gated behind an optional feature like Invoice Settlement or the legacy Order Metrics add-on.

Deliberately left out: standalone invoice creation/posting, payment creation/refunds/transfers, credit and debit memos, bill runs, usage/mediation, and every order-action type beyond creating a brand-new subscription — all real, documented Zuora endpoints, left out because covering them accurately would mean re-deriving a large fraction of Zuora's object model rather than a scoped, verifiable action set. `order-create`'s `subscriptions` field is deliberately raw JSON rather than a typed form for the same reason — see that action's own documentation for exactly what it accepts.
